## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Compatibility boundary

- [ ] Marketplace or plugin packaging
- [ ] Claude-native workflow behavior
- [ ] Upstream-derived content
- [ ] Artifact contract or deterministic helper
- [ ] Documentation only

## Verification

List the exact commands run and their results.

```text
commands and results
```

## Attribution and honesty

- [ ] Upstream attribution and modification notices remain intact.
- [ ] Supporting files required at runtime are inside the cached plugin directory.
- [ ] The change does not claim model behavior that was only schema- or loader-validated.
- [ ] No credentials, private source code, or sensitive scan output are included.
